# Compare slider (`compare-slider`)

Before / after split with a draggable divider.

Group: Media & editors. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/media';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createCompareSlider` (types in `dist/web/media/compareSlider.d.ts`): `.mh-compare` (`--vertical`): two panes stacked in one frame, "before" clipped to the divider's position, with a draggable divider (`__divider` with `__handle`) and corner labels (`__label--before | --after`). A press anywhere moves the divider; the keyboard drives a native range (`__input`, arrows, Page Up / Down, Home / End) that carries the name and value. `--_at` (0 to 1) on the root positions everything.

```ts
export function createCompareSlider(options: CompareSliderOptions): CompareSliderHandle;

export interface CompareSliderOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the divider ("Compare edits"). */
  label: string;
  before: CompareImage | Node;
  after: CompareImage | Node;
  beforeLabel?: string;
  afterLabel?: string;
  /** Share of the frame showing "before", 0 to 100 (default 50). */
  value?: number;
  /** `horizontal` (default) splits left / right; `vertical` splits top / bottom. */
  orientation?: CompareOrientation;
  /** Width / height (default 4 / 3). */
  aspect?: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onChange?: (value: number) => void;
}

export interface CompareSliderHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  getValue(): number;
  setValue(value: number): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
  destroy(): void;
}
```

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createCompareSlider, createText } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = createText('Showing 45% of the evening scene', { variant: 'caption', tone: 'muted' });

const compare = createCompareSlider({
  label: 'Compare the lighting scene',
  before: { src: 'photos/living-room-off.jpg', alt: 'Living room with the lights off' },
  after: { src: 'photos/living-room-evening.jpg', alt: 'Living room with the evening scene on' },
  beforeLabel: 'Off',
  afterLabel: 'Evening',
  value: 45,
  onChange: (value) => (status.textContent = `Showing ${Math.round(value)}% of the evening scene`),
});

document.body.append(compare.el, status);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { CompareSlider, Text } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function CompareSliderExample() {
  const [split, setSplit] = useState(45);
  return (
    <>
      <CompareSlider
        label="Compare the lighting scene"
        before={{ src: 'photos/living-room-off.jpg', alt: 'Living room with the lights off' }}
        after={{ src: 'photos/living-room-evening.jpg', alt: 'Living room with the evening scene on' }}
        beforeLabel="Off"
        afterLabel="Evening"
        value={split}
        onChange={setSplit}
      />
      <Text variant="caption" tone="muted">
        Showing {Math.round(split)}% of the evening scene
      </Text>
    </>
  );
}
```
